title: Observation of electron-antineutrino disappearance at Daya Bay
publisher: American Physical Society / Daya Bay Collaboration
excerpt: sin²(2θ₁₃) ≠ 0 at 5.2 standard deviations; R=0.940±0.011(stat)±0.004(syst); flux-weighted baselines of 470 m and 576 m; far hall at 1648 m; six 2.9 GW_th reactors; six antineutrino detectors.
